source_message.text:
Hey,

The account is funded, so I am ready to formalize the engagement. Welcome to the team—this is your confirmed offer.

**NEXT STEPS AND TIMELINE**
I will send the official Upwork contract shortly. After you accept it, you will receive your Instagram account login; once access is available, you will begin posting right away.

**COMPENSATION AND GROWTH**
Your **FLAT RETAINER: $700-900 per month** covers 140 approved clips per month. Only clips I personally approve count toward that quota. Anything that falls below the required standard will not count, because quality is the priority.

In addition to the retainer, every clip that reaches a view milestone earns a performance bonus. Better-performing clips can raise your monthly earnings above the base and give you the opportunity to exceed the flat fee each month.

This is real, it is long term, and it is just the beginning. From day one, you will have an open path toward becoming a Lead Clipper and earning $4,500 per month.

**ACCOUNT AND INSTAGRAM WORKFLOW**
You will be assigned a dedicated Instagram account for posting approved clips directly. Every posted clip will be tracked for views, performance, and engagement, with full transparency maintained throughout.

Let us build something great together.

Darius
